title: Waist-to-height ratio as an indicator of early health risk: simpler and more predictive than using a matrix based on BMI and waist circumference

keyFinding.enGB: Supports waist-to-height ratio as a simple central-adiposity marker that can flag elevated risk earlier than BMI alone in the studied cohorts.
